entities.summary: Yusuf bin Ismail bin Yusuf bin Ismail bin Muhammad Nâsir al-Dîn an-Nabhani (1849–1932) was a Palestinian Sunni Islamic scholar, judge, prolific poet, and defender of the Ottoman Caliphate.
